instruction: Implement {{symbol}} in {{entry}} using sqlite3 only. Given a connection with people(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL), transactionally add a non-null unique slug column. Derive each slug by ASCII-lowercasing name, replacing each maximal run outside [a-z0-9] by '-', and stripping '-'; use 'person' if empty. In ascending id order resolve collisions using -2, -3, ... against all already-used complete slugs (including natural suffixed names). Preserve ids/names, commit on success, roll back every schema/data change on failure, and make a completed migration idempotent. Refuse a partially migrated/incompatible schema without changing it. The caller has no active transaction. Propagate an exception on failure.
